lastCompletedStory.title: Trim vestigial node-era options param from the SpawnFn seam type

nextStoryContext: SpawnFn in scripts/check-all.ts is now (cmd: string, args: string[]) => SyncSubprocess<'inherit','inherit'>; the third options param and the node-era { encoding: 'utf8'; stdio?: 'inherit'|'pipe' } shape are gone. Default impl in runGates still hardcodes Bun.spawnSync([cmd, ...args], { cwd, stdin: 'inherit', stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit' }) unchanged. Test fake in test/check-all.test.ts (makeRecordingSpawn) trimmed to 2-param signature to match.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Bun.spawnSync's OptionsObject has no encoding key and no scalar stdio:'inherit'|'pipe' string; streams are configured via stdin/stdout/stderr (or a stdio tuple). Validates that the trimmed SpawnFn type (no options param) is correct and the removed node-era shape was fully vestigial.
